description: Vercel AI SDK v6 generateText with an Anthropic prompt marked for cache.
notes: Telemetry is enabled through experimental_telemetry. recordInputs and recordOutputs stay at their defaults, which record message content on spans. The system message sets providerOptions.anthropic.cacheControl to ephemeral. Scripted usage is input 2100, output 40, cache_read 1800, cache_write 200. The spans copy an inclusive input of 2100. inputTokenDetails holds noCacheTokens 100, cacheReadTokens 1800, and cacheWriteTokens 200, so the cache write does not depend on providerMetadata. providerMetadata.anthropic.cacheCreationInputTokens is still 200. ai.response.timestamp is the process clock.
